reviewer: Coordinating author after author review and a separate specialist examination audit
scope: Two original 100-point written forms, 40 fully solved parts, six answered diagnostic items, full original policy practical and computational package, five oral benchmarks, six retention answers, scoring, remediation, coverage and synthesis.

root_review.written_and_support: Verified the independent specialist record covering every prompt and solution in both forms, all diagnostic, oral and retention items, scoring and source scope. All eight final reviewed section hashes match. The root review does not replace this separately attributed full written-paper review.
root_review.practical: Read the full practical prompt and instructor guide, all inputs, benchmark output and README. Independently reconstructed household and firm choices, the global welfare gap certificate, compensation intervals, current and terminal household budgets, national accounts, public maturity/issuance, external flows and FX valuation. Verified all four policies including carbon-tax welfare 304/3, tariff-plus-tax welfare 96, auction welfare 100 and baseline 96. Terminal settlement closes every financial claim and prevents treating borrowed imports as free wealth.
root_review.public_and_external_accounts: Public gross issuance 31 and closing debt 56 follow maturity 25, interest 2 and primary deficit 4. CA=19-8M, opening NFA=-40, FX revaluation +1 and closing NFA=-39+CA agree. One-period auction permissions are stipulated current production levies with no carried permit asset; their classification is not generalized to real permit systems.
root_review.identification: Independently checked all 20 equally likely three-of-six offer assignments, contrast -2 and two-sided sharp-null p=1/5. Excluded the post-cutoff revision; its contrast -5/3 happens to retain the same p-value, demonstrating why a p-value check alone misses leakage. Offer ITT is not a national carbon-tax estimate.
root_review.computation: Read benchmark and focused checker, including independent first-order/cash-flow/expenditure reconstruction, supported-domain checks, failure probes and portable CLI. Root execution passes all 18 groups: 56 numeric fields per policy, 123 policy boundary/sensitivity cases, 31 invalid contracts and seven damaged results. Finite checks supplement explicit global arguments.
root_review.sources: Ten method-specific records reuse actual primary bodies already inspected for accepted chapters. Reviewed their stated scopes; no new national observations or fresh whole-source audit is claimed.
root_review.integration: Acceptance-state build and whole-library verifier pass: 75 accepted chapters, six accepted volume packages, two accepted cumulative packages and 88 HTML pages. Browser search-index syntax and git diff whitespace checks pass. Offline archive has 215 files and passes ZIP integrity; deployment follows.

resolved_findings: Specified seniority, proportional unpaid-depositor sharing and nonnegative owner residual in the stressed bank problem.
Added a complete finite terminal settlement to the practical, including debt repayment, inherited foreign claims and capital payoff.
Clarified current-production-levy treatment and no permit asset for the one-period auction example.
Expanded the fourth oral benchmark to answer the explicit capital-accumulation/growth link.
Corrected joined words and numerical amounts in support answers.
limitations: Agent review is not independent human grading or institutional certification.
Authored timing and scoring thresholds are not empirically calibrated.
The practical is an original conditional synthetic model, not an estimated policy forecast.
Visual/mobile/print UI QA remains pending under the recorded browser restriction.
